value.rationale: Adafactor's memory saving comes directly from replacing a full matrix second moment by row and column marginals. The theorem gives the smallest-dimensional exact error law and an information-theoretic obstruction showing that marginal-only reconstruction cannot uniformly preserve coordinatewise adaptive scales. The dynamic construction makes the obstruction optimizer-relevant rather than merely a matrix-approximation curiosity.
